title: 第15章 强制良家妇男沧溟第16章 难道我的腰不好摸吗
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
一阵折腾之后天都已经黑了下去，原本还在欣赏自己的江欲突然想起来自己忘记了一件很重要的事情。
她之前和沧溟打赌的时候是她赢了，但是赌注她还没来得及让沧溟实现。
“不行，我现在就要去找他。”
江欲说着直接出门了，脑子里浮现出沧溟之前穿着衣服时的样子。
沧溟一件玄色深衣外罩墨蓝长袍，虽然是魔族可是却不像是她印象中的魔族一样袒胸露乳。
他的腰带束得规规矩矩，可布料底下什么都藏不住，腰身自然收束，与肩背形成陡峭落差，侧腰弧线像刀锋。
衣袖虽然宽大，可他今天抬手时布料绷紧，底下长条肌肉一闪而过，一看平常就没少练。
江欲越想越兴奋，有些猥琐的笑容让系统都有些害怕。
【宿主，你确定这样不会吓到沧溟吗？】
江欲没管系统，只是走到了沧溟的门口，抬手敲了敲门：“沧溟，你在房间吗？”
里面很安静，很久都没有人说话。
“难道是出门了？不可能啊，这么晚他能去哪里……”
江欲摸着下巴思索了两秒，然后就这么直推开门走了进去，映入眼帘的就是正要洗澡的沧溟。
沧溟的外袍刚脱了一半，腰带散开，中衣半褪，露出一截精瘦的腰腹。
他听见动静猛地抬头，在看到江欲的瞬间就手忙脚乱地把衣襟拢到胸口紧紧捂着，活像被登徒子堵住门的良家女子。
“江欲？？来干什么？”他声音都紧了，像是想到了之前她强迫元梵的样子，忍不住往后退了一步。
江欲的目光毫不客气地往他腰间扫了一圈，眼睛都亮了起来：“我能来干嘛，当然是来让你履行赌约的。”
“早上你输了，你不会忘了吧？”
沧溟一愣，随即想起晨起时那个江欲作弊的打赌，脸上的表情从惊惶变成恼怒：“所以呢？”
“所以，让我摸摸腹肌。”江欲理直气壮。

沧溟在意识到江欲之前说的摸自己居然是真的，脸腾地红了，一手捂着衣襟一手指着门口：“你、你这个流氓！”
江欲压根不在乎他骂了什么，什么流氓不流氓的，她本来就是。
更何况现在的沧溟失去了魔力不过是个普通人，就算她硬来他也只能受着。
她往前迈了一步。
“等一下！”沧溟被这一步吓得猛地后退，脊背撞上屏风发出一声闷响。
他一只手还死死攥着衣襟，另一只手胡乱挡在身前，耳根红透了：“我、我还没准备好！”
江欲出人意料的停下了脚步，她低头看了看自己伸出去的手，又抬头看了看沧溟那张涨红的脸。
那张脸上除了羞恼，还有一丝无处躲藏的慌张。
她把手收了回来。
“行。”江欲说，“给你点时间准备。”
反正你也逃不了，她在心里说。
沧溟愣住，似乎不敢相信这么好说话的人会是江欲。
惊愕之余，他的目光不由自主地在她脸上停留了两秒，突然发现江欲似乎变得好看了点。
“你……吃了什么？”他下意识问了一句。
“别岔开话题。”江欲抱着胳膊，“准备好了吗？”
content_en:
After a while of tossing and turning, it was already dark. Jiang Yu, who was still admiring himself, suddenly remembered that he had forgotten something very important.
She had won the bet with Cang Ming before, but she had not had time to let Cang Ming realize the bet.
"No, I have to go find him now."
Jiang Yu said and went out directly, thinking of how Cangming looked when he was wearing clothes before.
Cangming wore a dark black coat and a dark blue robe. Although he was a demon, he was not as bare-chested as the demons in her impression.
His belt is neatly tied, but nothing can be hidden under the fabric. His waist is naturally tightened, forming a steep gap with his shoulders and back, and the curve of his side waist is like a blade.
Although the sleeves were wide, the fabric was taut when he raised his hand today, and the long muscles underneath flashed through, showing that he had been practicing regularly.
The more Jiang Yu thought about it, the more excited he became, and his lewd smile made the system a little scared.
[Host, are you sure this won’t scare Cangming? 】
Jiang Yu ignored the system and just walked to Cangming's door, raised his hand and knocked on the door: "Cangming, are you in the room?"
It was very quiet inside, and no one spoke for a long time.
"Did he go out? Impossible, where could he go so late..."
Jiang Yu touched his chin and thought for two seconds, then opened the door and walked in. What he saw was Cangming who was about to take a shower.
Cangming had just taken off half of his outer robe, his belt was untied, and his middle coat was half off, revealing a lean waist and abdomen.
He suddenly raised his head when he heard the movement, and the moment he saw Jiang Yu, he hurriedly gathered the skirt of his clothes to his chest and held it tightly, like a good girl whose door was blocked by an adulterer.
"Jiang Yu?? What are you doing here?" His voice was tight, as if he thought of how she forced Yuan Fan before, and couldn't help but take a step back.
Jiang Yu's eyes swept around his waist unceremoniously, and his eyes lit up: "Why am I here? Of course I'm here to let you fulfill your bet."
"You lost this morning, you won't forget it, right?"
Cangming was stunned for a moment, then remembered the bet that Jiang Yu cheated on in the morning, and the expression on his face changed from panic to anger: "So?"
"So, let me feel your abdominal muscles." Jiang Yu said confidently.
When Cangming realized that what Jiang Yu said about touching him before was actually true, his face turned red. He covered his clothes with one hand and pointed at the door: "You, you rogue!"
Jiang Yu didn't care what he scolded at all. She was a gangster and not a gangster.
What's more, Cang Ming has lost his magic power and is just an ordinary person. Even if she forces herself, he can only endure it.
She took a step forward.
"Wait a minute!" Cangming was so frightened by this step that he stepped back suddenly, and his back hit the screen with a muffled sound.
One of his hands was still clutching the hem of his clothes, and the other hand was in front of him. His ears were red: "I, I'm not ready yet!"
Jiang Yu stopped unexpectedly. She looked down at her outstretched hand, then looked up at Cangming's flushed face.
In addition to the shame and anger on that face, there was also a trace of panic that had nowhere to hide.
She pulled her hand back.
"Okay." Jiang Yu said, "I'll give you some time to prepare."
You can't escape anyway, she said in her mind.
Cangming was stunned, as if he couldn't believe that such an easy-to-talk person was Jiang Yu.
Astonished, his eyes couldn't help but stay on her face for two seconds, and suddenly found that Jiang Yu seemed to look better.
"What...did you eat?" He asked subconsciously.
"Don't change the subject." Jiang Yu crossed his arms, "Are you ready?"
